# seerr_sonarr_root_folders (Data Source)

Fetch Sonarr root folders via /api/v3/rootfolder.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "seerr_sonarr_root_folders" "example" {
  api_key = "your-sonarr-api-key"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `api_key` (String, Sensitive) Sonarr API key.

### Optional

- `base_url` (String) Base path when Sonarr is served under a subpath.
- `hostname` (String) Sonarr hostname when url is not provided.
- `port` (Number) Sonarr port when url is not provided.
- `url` (String) Full Sonarr URL. If set, it takes precedence over hostname, port, use_ssl, and base_url.
- `use_ssl` (Boolean) Use HTTPS when url is not provided.

### Read-Only

- `root_folders` (Attributes List) List of root folders from Sonarr. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--root_folders))

<a id="nestedatt--root_folders"></a>
### Nested Schema for `root_folders`

Read-Only:

- `accessible` (Boolean) Whether the root folder is accessible.
- `free_space` (Number) Free space in bytes.
- `id` (Number) Root folder ID.
- `path` (String) Root folder path.
